2115940242918350906.en_summary: $NVDA is reportedly in talks to provide over $5B in credit guarantees for Nscale's 460MW data center backed by a $45B $ANT compute contract. Nvidia would essentially be financing power and construction rather than GPUs, which could help bring more Vera Rubin capacity online faster while lowering borrowing costs for its customers.
2115940242918350906.zh_summary: $NVDA 據報正洽談為 Nscale 的 460MW 數據中心提供超過 50 億美元信用擔保，該數據中心有 450 億美元 $ANT 算力合約支持。Nvidia 實質上是在為電力與建設融資而非 GPU，這可能有助於更快將更多 Vera Rubin 產能上線，同時降低客戶借款成本。

ticker_notes.NVDA: 提供超過50億美元信用擔保，加速 Vera Rubin 產能上線並降低客戶融資成本

2115935868678775080.en_summary: $AMZN plans to start selling Trainium chips outside AWS in late 2027, with CEO Andy Jassy expecting “a very significant business selling chips externally.” Jassy notes those same chips generate more cash flow inside AWS over 5 to 6 years, so Amazon aims to capture both direct chip sales and years of recurring cloud revenue.
2115935868678775080.zh_summary: $AMZN 計劃於 2027 年末開始在 AWS 以外銷售 Trainium 芯片，CEO Andy Jassy 預期「對外銷售芯片將成為非常重要的業務」。Jassy 指出這些芯片在 AWS 內部可於 5 至 6 年內產生更多現金流，因此亞馬遜希望同時獲取直接芯片銷售收入與多年持續的雲端收入。

ticker_notes.AMZN: 2027 年末對外銷售 Trainium 芯片，預期成為重要業務，並同時獲取雲端現金流
